en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a serene lakeside landscape with trees in the foreground, a calm lake with two boats (one rowboat and one canoe), and forested hills in the background. Text at the bottom includes 'Hiidenvesi' and 'Vihti - Wichtis.' There is handwritten script in Swedish or Finnish, and the name 'O. J. Dahlberg' appears, likely the photographer or publisher.
